title: Bitcoin against the Benchmarks — Correlation
note: align-v2 · breadth-v2 · Rolling 365-session correlation of daily log RETURNS, on a shared trading calendar — the assets do not all trade every day, and returns taken across a weekend the other market slept through are not the same interval. Correlating price LEVELS instead would measure two trends and report it as a relationship. A window this long is stable but slow: it is still carrying observations from a year ago, so read the level, not the last week of it.
